description: Look up a Nigerian administrative boundary (state, LGA or ward) by name. Returns the centroid, bounding box and attribution — not the full polygon. Example: { level: 'state', name: 'Lagos' }. Data: GRID3, CC BY 4.0.

level.description: Administrative level: state, lga or ward

name: get_boundary

attribution.description: Data licence attribution, e.g. 'GRID3, CC BY 4.0'

centroid.description: Representative centre point of the boundary

name.description: Canonical boundary name as recorded by the source, e.g. 'Lagos'

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

title: Get Nigerian admin boundary
